diagnostics.message: "goes-nicely-with" is not a pairing relation (expected one of pairs-with, substitutes-for). The relation selects which sentence the read renders — 'vai bem com' invites an addition, 'no lugar' answers an absence — so an unknown one is an edge with no way to be spoken. Adding a relation is a template change and a claim-type conversation, not a row.
